answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The quartz cap is enforced at intake and inlet shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a opal tag. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
